candidates.reason: This module directly imports and unit-tests scrapy.utils.response.open_in_browser, the function changed by this PR. Its existing cases assert that an HtmlResponse is written with an .html extension, a TextResponse with a .txt extension, and a bare (non-text) Response raises TypeError. The PR replaces that TypeError path with extension selection driven by the Content-Type header, so these tests are the primary place to update/add cases (for example image/png -> .png, application/pdf -> .pdf, and fallback behavior for unknown or missing Content-Type).

These integration tests exercise the 'scrapy view' command, which delegates to open_in_browser through scrapy.commands.view.Command._print_response. That method currently short-circuits with 'Cannot view a non-text response.' for every non-TextResponse, and TestViewCommand.test_non_text_response asserts that refusal. If this PR lifts the command-level restriction so non-text responses can be opened by Content-Type, this test must be updated to assert the browser is opened with a Content-Type-derived extension (the fixture already fetches /static/files/images/scrapy.png).
